arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-10-01' AND date < '2019-11-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in October 2019, which is last month relative to the end of the data.
assumptions: 'Last month' is resolved against the end of the data (2019-10-31), so it means October 2019 (2019-10-01 up to but not including 2019-11-01).
All transactions are counted, including those with no fraud label and those with negative amounts.
